annotations.title: Search product recalls and safety alerts

description: Product recalls and safety alerts from regulators in one schema: US FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, medical devices), US CPSC consumer products, Health Canada / CFIA / Transport Canada, UK Food Standards Agency and OPSS, and the EU Safety Gate. Product, brands, company, hazard, class, date, distribution, remedy and official link. Newest first. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/recalls-radar on your Apify account (about $0.002 per recall; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

keywords.description: Matched on title, product, brand, company and hazard, e.g. ["peanut", "lithium battery", "Acme"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

posted_within_days.description: Only recalls published in the last N days.

name: search_recalls

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search product recalls and safety alerts
